payload.claim: The seventh (preserves) criterion's claim states the retired corpus "still refuses only on depends_on and on SA-0063's disclosed mutant," but the actual preserved test (tests/test_scheduler.py:3691) asserts three categories, not two: SA-0063's disclosed-mutant refusal, ten specs refused under protected_touch for touching .claude/ (pinned by id, backlog item b-e471bd, SA-0279), and everything else under depends_on. The claim's sentence omits the .claude-touching category and so is not a fully accurate description of the current code/test at this snapshot. Since this criterion is preserves: true and the Notes explicitly instruct "Do not edit it," nothing is built from this inaccuracy and the existing test continues to pass either way - it costs nothing to leave for the operator, but it is worth a one-line correction for clarity.
